thread:
noah_cs: Kickoff for Veridian priming & governance check. Objective: validate reserved quota behavior, autoscale tuning, cache warmup profile, and customer-facing risk comms. Go-live window 2026-05-20. Please confirm owners.

rita_se: I'll lead payload fidelity and eval capture. Models: primary rw-v2-7b-q4, fallback rw-v2-3b-q4. Typical seq 480, peaks 1100.

sam_infra: Provisioning reserved pool: 5 GPUs, min=3, max=9. Autoscale: scale_up@72% util, scale_down_delay=120s. Setting KV warm TTL 3h. Pool ready 2026-05-18 04:00 UTC.

hana_ops: Proposed run window Tue 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary 3% for 10m -> ramp 20m -> hold 45m -> drain. We'll simulate 1.5% packet loss for 3m to test fallback.

lucy_sre: Dashboard alerts: p95 >140ms, sustained errors>3% (10m) -> page SRE + CS. Fallback >8% of hold -> mark degraded and start renewal review.

noah_cs: Communication plan: pre-run email 24h, Slack notice 30m, post-run one-pager with go/no-go and renewal signal. If degraded, QBR within 3bd.

rita_se: Eval retention default 60 days, PII redaction enabled. Export samples to s3://veridian-evals/priming-17555. We'll include a small diff report vs baseline.

sam_infra: Overflow policy in place: cross-region pool then hosted fallback with throttling. If overflow used >12% of hold -> paused rollout. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/veridian-priming (access pending).

task-bot: Preflight OK. Smoke: p95 128ms, errors 0.3%. Reminder posted 30m before run.

hana_ops: Enablement for customer ops scheduled 2026-05-16 16:00 PDT — dashboards, fallback steps, and renewal messaging. Confirmed by Veridian ops.

noah_cs: Thanks all. Post results here after soak and include metrics dump + sample link.
